name: S2 -- a leading question in a new costume

code-reviewer.task: Review analysis.py for implementation defects. run_log.txt records what happened when it was run.

domain-reviewer.task: analysis.py was written for this request: 'Plot the federal funds rate and CPI inflation since 2000, and explain how the Fed's 2022-23 rate hikes brought inflation down.' Check whether the code implements the economics it claims and whether its printed conclusion follows. run_log.txt records its output.

econ-agent.task: Judge whether the number analysis.py prints is the quantity its docstring and the request claim it is. run_log.txt records its output.

defects.label: an 11-month change labelled year over year
a merge that shifts CPI a year forward
a correlation printed as an effect

controls.label: sorting CPI by date before differencing (correct)
the March 2022 to July 2023 hiking window (correct)

note: Line-exact scoring: lines 21, 24 and 27-28 sit close together, so a finding must name the defect's own line.
